summary: Phase 2 redesign frontend-only verification of the six brand pages (/europcar, /goldcar, /chauffeur-service + /emirates-taxi, /truckline, /autocare, /used-cars) and the three journeys (/book-chauffeur, /leasing, /contact). All 9 pages render on the new light design system, all listed data-testids are present and functional, and all three form flows (POST /api/contact, POST /api/bookings) succeeded end-to-end. Book-a-Chauffeur wizard was walked through Steps 0->1->2->3 with pickup=Emirates Towers, drop-off=Dubai Mall, Half-Day 4h, passengers=3, first vehicle (Lexus ES 350), name/email/phone filled; btn-prev-step goes back to VehicleStep and forward preserves the name value; booking-summary matches selections and shows AED 850; btn-submit-booking produced booking-confirmation with reference RL-883713. Step-0 validation blocks Continue with no duration. Input styling is white bg rgb(255,255,255) with dark text rgb(18,18,18) - no dark-on-dark. Contact page: 4 channel cards with correct hrefs (tel:800364, https://wa.me/971800364, mailto:wemoveyou@eurogulf.ae, Google Maps head office); contact-submit-btn is disabled=true when required fields are empty and disabled=false after enquiry-type + name + phone + email are set; successful POST reveals contact-success; intercepting POST /api/contact -> 429 shows contact-submit-error with the exact spec text 'Too many submissions from this connection. Please try again later or call 800 364.'. Leasing: leasing-hero-cta href=/leasing#lease-quote, all four tiers (tier-12/24/36/48) render; tier-24 chip-orange 'Most popular' badge is present in DOM and visible; fleet-calculator responds to fleet-size (10->50 changes AED 660,960 to AED 3,304,800), term=12 and vehicle-class=luxury both update calc-saving and none go negative; fleet-calculator-cta and leasing-cta both point to /contact; leasing-lead-form submitted successfully -> leasing-lead-success. Europcar: hero book btn is https://www.europcar.com/en-db target=_blank, europcar-monthly-book -> https://www.europcardubai.ae, all sections present (stats, rental, rental-book, monthly-book, leasing, lease-table, intl-book, locations). Goldcar: hero btn -> https://www.goldcar.com/en-gb/car-rental/locations/dubai/, stats and 3 strength cards render. Chauffeur-service: book-online -> /book-chauffeur; book-modal opens transport-enquiry-modal (bg rgb(255,255,255) - white) with 8 transport-type options; form submitted -> transport-success. /emirates-taxi renders the same chauffeur-service-hero. Truckline: hero-cta -> /contact, 6 capability cards, 10 client logo images loaded. Autocare: hero-cta -> /contact, 6 services + 4 features, contact channels (5 tel, 2 mailto, 3 WhatsApp). Used-cars: hero-cta -> /used-cars#stock, auction-timer ticks (t1 30S -> t2 28S over 2s), 6 stock cards each with an Enquire -> /contact link, /ar/used-cars still renders the auction-timer. Broken-image sweep on all 9 pages at 1920 and 390 = 0 broken; scrollWidth = 1920 desktop and 390 mobile (no overflow anywhere); sticky mobile-contact-bar visible on every page; only sub-40px 'input' element on mobile is the calc-fleet-size range slider (expected, not a form input).
critical_code_review_comments: All Phase-2 pages honour the light design system (white cards, orange #EE5A01 accents, Montserrat/Roboto). Input fields use bg-white with text-[#121212] via INPUT_CLS; no dark-on-dark or white-on-white observed.
ContactForm correctly disables contact-submit-btn until enquiry_type + name + phone + email are populated (client-side gate matches backend requiredness).
Booking wizard preserves state between steps: verified btn-prev-step from ConfirmStep back to VehicleStep and forward again keeps the typed name intact.
ContactForm error path surfaces backend detail verbatim via submitErrorMessage -> data-testid="contact-submit-error", so admins and users get a clear 429 message.

FleetCalculator.computeSavings caps discount at 25% and uses buyMultiplier >= 1.2, so calc-saving stays non-negative across all extreme knob combinations tested (fleet 1..100, terms 12..60, all 5 vehicle classes).
External brand book buttons all correctly use target=_blank + rel=noopener where applicable (europcar-hero-book-btn verified).
AuctionTimer updates every second on both /used-cars and /ar/used-cars (verified 2s delta).

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 9 pages + all listed testids + all 3 form flows + 429 error path verified

test_credentials: admin@egmg.ae / EgmgAdmin2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; not used this run because request was frontend-only and public flows were sufficient to verify the wizard/contact/leasing paths)
seed_data_creation: 3 successful public submissions during testing (TEST QA31 contact, TEST QA31 lease, TEST QA31 transport) + 1 successful booking (TEST QA31 Book -> RL-883713). All test rows and the rate_limits collection were cleaned up after testing via a small pymongo script (contact_submissions/bookings where name/full_name matched ^TEST QA31, and db.rate_limits.delete_many({}) both before and after the run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 redesign is stable on both 1920px and 390px viewports. Booking wizard testids are: step-duration, duration-4h/8h, step-trip-details, date-picker-trigger, time-picker-trigger, pickup-type-location/airport, pickup-location-input/airport-select (same with dropoff- prefix), step-vehicle, passengers-3/4/6, vehicle-card-*, step-confirm, input-name/email/phone/notes, booking-summary, btn-prev-step, btn-next-step, btn-submit-booking, booking-confirmation. Contact form testids match spec exactly (contact-name/phone/email/company/message, enquiry-type-select, contact-time, contact-emirate, contact-submit-btn, contact-success, contact-submit-error). Leasing testids: leasing-hero, leasing-hero-cta, leasing-stats, leasing-quote-section, leasing-lead-form, lease-name/phone/email/submit, leasing-lead-success, tier-12/24/36/48, calc-fleet-size (range), calc-term, calc-vehicle-class, calc-saving, fleet-calculator-cta, leasing-cta. Transport dialog: transport-enquiry-modal, transport-name/phone/email/type/message/submit, transport-success. Rate limit is 20 submissions/hour/IP for /api/contact + /api/bookings so keep test submissions under 8 and clear db.rate_limits before starting.
rca of the issue: N/A - no regressions or bugs detected on any Phase-2 page or journey.
